passages.text: Kestrel runs spot and annual carrier tenders and compares bids by lane, price and on-time history.
Shipment tracking combines carrier status messages and GPS data from telematics providers such as project44.
Orders arrive by EDIFACT IFTMIN, API or CSV upload, and status goes back to the ERP through webhooks.
A certified SAP S/4HANA add-on creates transport orders from deliveries and posts freight costs back to SAP.
Freight invoices are matched against agreed rates automatically, and only deviations go to a person for approval.
CO2e per shipment is calculated with the GLEC Framework and ISO 14083 for reporting.
Kestrel is hosted in Microsoft Azure Germany West Central in Frankfurt.
Pricing is based on shipments per year, and the sales team sends a quote after a scoping call.
The interface is available in German, English, Dutch and Polish.
A typical rollout takes 8 to 12 weeks, including carrier onboarding.
